verdict.rationale: LegalOS says its attorneys are 'paired with AI workflows' (legalos-docs-17), and it offers data-driven outputs such as eligibility assessments and evidence mapped to O-1 criteria (legalos-docs-1, legalos-docs-12, legalos-docs-15). However, the personalized assessment is attributed to immigration attorneys, not AI, and none of these outputs is explicitly described as AI-generated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own case data, a description of how those AI outputs are surfaced in the product, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
